title: Gemini (LLM)
description: Google's Gemini models as an LLM tier, through gohort's Gemini client, with the key kept in a credential rather than in the LLM settings.
setup_notes: Create a key at aistudio.google.com/apikey. The credential lands disabled: enable it under API Credentials. Run Test on its row under Admin > Extensions > Connectors, which makes one short real chat. Then put it to use by choosing it under Admin > LLMs > Worker LLM (or Lead LLM) as Service: <name>: the tier's turns run on it through gohort's own Gemini client, streaming and tool calls as usual, and the key stays in the credential. Choosing Gemini with a key on the LLM form, or in first-run setup, installs this template for you. Its calls and their cost show on the connector's row; add per_million_input and per_million_output to its spec's cost to price its tokens, which then replace the tier's rates under Costs.
